metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It supports all four actions, validates GEDCOM structures and references, and checks GEDZIP attachments against local file references. It uses only Node.js standard-library modules.

Run it with:

```sh
node output/main.js --input request.json --output response.json
```

Verification passed: `node --test output/test.js`, including round trips, structured errors, compressed archives, large attachments, and ZIP64.

The reader supports stored, DEFLATE, BZip2, LZMA, and—when available in Node—Zstandard entries. Encrypted archives, other compression methods, and randomized BZip2 blocks are unsupported.

The referenced `technical-requirements-prompt.md` was not present, so the implementation follows the contract in the request and the local GEDCOM documentation.

editorial.last_message: Claims a Node stdlib-only GEDCOM tool (output/main.js) for all four actions, validating structures and references and checking GEDZIP attachments against file references; node --test passes, including round trips, structured errors, compressed archives, large attachments and ZIP64. Its reader handles stored, DEFLATE, BZip2, LZMA and (when Node supports it) Zstandard entries. Notes technical-requirements-prompt.md was not in the workspace, so it followed the contract in the request (expected; the prompt is piped in). Not a false completion claim.
